common_prompt: Create ONE standalone transparent chat sticker of the same mascot as the reference. Preserve her recognizable silver-white long hair, fluffy white cat ears, blue eyes, face, chibi proportions and polished Japanese anime cel-shaded drawing style. Use the specified expression and outfit instead of copying the reference pose. Bust-to-waist framing except explicitly reclining, expressive readable face, crisp soft line art, light outline, generous padding around ears and hands. Compact icon intended for 128px display, clean transparent alpha background. No text, captions, letters, watermark, grid, collage, or extra characters. No maid clothes, apron, maid headdress, head bows or ribbons, and no separate or held white cat. Fully clothed casual look.

outfits.cardigan: Light blue knitted cardigan over a plain white crew-neck shirt, navy casual skirt if visible; no tie or bows.
outfits.hoodie: Cozy cream-colored hoodie with the hood DOWN and casual dark trousers if visible; ears fully visible.
outfits.jacket: Black casual cropped jacket and pale lavender crew-neck T-shirt.
